name: Auto Detail Plus S700
description: A concentrated prespray designed for professional automotive upholstery and carpet detailing, cutting through ground in traffic lane soiling with ease. Formulated with powerful surfactants to loosen and suspend heavy soiling before hot water extraction or dry vacuuming.

name: Nasty AquaClean S601
description: A high alkaline aqua prespray engineered to tackle extreme soiling, greasy residues, and heavily contaminated traffic lanes in commercial environments. Its fast acting formula penetrates deep into carpet fibres to emulsify stubborn soils prior to extraction.

name: Power Blast R130
description: A professional grade powdered prespray with an aggressive alkaline formula, delivering maximum soil suspension and degreasing power on heavily trafficked carpets and rugs. Dissolves in water to create a ready to use spray that boosts extraction efficiency and restores carpet brightness.

name: Power Blast R130
description: A professional grade powdered prespray with an aggressive alkaline formula, delivering maximum soil suspension and degreasing power on heavily trafficked carpets and rugs. Dissolves in water to create a ready to use spray that boosts extraction efficiency and restores carpet brightness.

name: Enzym PRO98
description: A premium enzyme based prespray containing a high concentration blend of protease, lipase, and amylase enzymes that biologically break down organic soils, food residues, and bodily fluids in carpet fibres. Ideal for deep treatment before hot water extraction, leaving carpets hygienically clean and odour free.

name: Enzym PRO98
description: A premium enzyme based prespray containing a high concentration blend of protease, lipase, and amylase enzymes that biologically break down organic soils, food residues, and bodily fluids in carpet fibres. Ideal for deep treatment before hot water extraction, leaving carpets hygienically clean and odour free.

name: Acid Ocean Rinse S550
description: An acidic rinse agent formulated for use in the final rinse stage of hot water extraction, neutralising alkaline prespray residues and restoring the carpet's natural pH balance. Leaves fibres soft, residue free, and static resistant, significantly improving pile appearance and drying conditions.

name: Hydra AquaClean S602
description: A low foaming extraction liquid specially formulated for use in hot water extraction machines, combining powerful cleaning surfactants with a built in agent that prevents resoiling. It efficiently removes suspended soils during the extraction pass while protecting carpet fibres from rapid recontamination.

name: Extraction Clean S880
description: A professional powdered extraction compound that dissolves cleanly into extraction machine tanks, releasing a controlled foam formula to lift and suspend deep seated soils without flooding the substrate. Suitable for truck mount and portable extraction systems, delivering bright, fast drying results.

name: Extraction Clean S880
description: A professional powdered extraction compound that dissolves cleanly into extraction machine tanks, releasing a controlled foam formula to lift and suspend deep seated soils without flooding the substrate. Suitable for truck mount and portable extraction systems, delivering bright, fast drying results.

name: Finish B110
description: A finishing extraction powder designed to add a protective coating to carpet fibres at the end of the cleaning process, enhancing texture and brightness while providing a soil retardant barrier. Its low moisture powder format minimises drying times and leaves a professionally finished appearance.

name: Single Pass S103
description: A high efficiency single pass extraction powder engineered to clean and rinse in one machine pass, drastically reducing job time on lightly to moderately soiled carpets. Combines detergent and rinse agents in a single formula that leaves carpets clean, deodorised, and drying quickly.

name: WoolSafe B134
description: A WoolSafe approved, pH neutral detergent formulated specifically for the safe cleaning of wool, silk, and delicate blended fibre carpets and rugs without risk of shrinkage or dye damage. Its gentle surfactant system effectively removes soiling and staining while preserving the natural lustre and texture of fine textile fibres.

name: Dry Clean Solvent P235
description: A professional strength dry cleaning solvent for upholstery, curtains, and water sensitive fine fabrics that cannot tolerate aqueous cleaning methods. It safely dissolves oil based soils, grease marks, and adhesive residues without wetting the substrate, eliminating shrinkage and watermark risks.

name: Acid Ocean Rinse S550
description: An acidic rinse agent suitable for use on fine fabrics as a final step neutraliser following alkaline cleaning treatments, restoring the fabric's natural pH and preventing residue build up. Its gentle acid balance helps lock in dye vibrancy and leaves delicate fabrics soft and conditioned after treatment.

name: Citra X Out A370
description: A citrus based deodoriser and neutraliser that chemically eliminates malodours at their source rather than simply masking them, using natural citrus extracts to break down odour causing organic compounds. Highly effective on musty odours, pet smells, and traffic lane contamination in carpets and upholstery.

name: Sta Kill E205
description: A broad spectrum sanitising agent formulated to kill bacteria, fungi, and odour producing microorganisms on contact in carpets and soft furnishings. Its residual antimicrobial action provides lasting protection, making it ideal for use in high traffic commercial environments, nurseries, and care facilities.

name: Sta Kill E206 No Perfume
description: An unperfumed version of the Sta Kill sanitising formula, designed for use in environments where fragrance sensitivity is a concern such as hospitals, dental practices, and allergy aware households. Delivers the same broad spectrum antimicrobial efficacy as E205 without any added fragrance compounds.

name: Defoamer T502
description: A high concentration silicone based defoamer additive for use in extraction machine tanks and recovery vessels to instantly collapse foam build up caused by overuse of cleaning chemicals or heavily soiled substrates. A small dose added directly to the dirty water tank prevents vacuum motor damage and maintains extraction efficiency throughout the job.

name: Heavy Soil
description: A high alkaline booster additive designed to be mixed with prespray solutions when tackling exceptionally heavy soiling, grease contamination, or long neglected carpets that require additional cleaning power. Enhances the performance of standard presprays without leaving harmful residues that could attract future soiling.

name: 3in1
description: A spot remover that simultaneously cleans, deodorises, and conditions in a single application, tackling a wide variety of everyday stains including coffee, wine, mud, and food residues on carpets and upholstery. Its three in one formula reduces treatment steps and delivers a professional finish without the need for post treatment rinsing.

name: OxyGO G101
description: An oxygen activated stain remover that releases active oxygen on contact with the stain to break down and bleach out stubborn organic staining including red wine, blood, fruit juice, and tannin based marks on carpets and upholstery. Safe for use on most colourfast fibres, it works without aggressive solvents and is suitable for both professional cleaning and routine maintenance.

name: OxyGO G101
description: An oxygen activated stain remover that releases active oxygen on contact with the stain to break down and bleach out stubborn organic staining including red wine, blood, fruit juice, and tannin based marks on carpets and upholstery. Safe for use on most colourfast fibres, it works without aggressive solvents and is suitable for both professional cleaning and routine maintenance.

name: P.O.G. Paint Oil Grease P101
description: A solvent based spot remover specifically formulated to dissolve and lift paint, oil, and grease stains from carpet and upholstery fibres without damaging the substrate. Effective on both wet and dried deposits of trade paints, motor oil, lipstick, and wax, it evaporates cleanly and leaves no sticky residue.

name: Stain Remover Plus C521
description: A professional strength multi purpose stain remover concentrate for high volume use, formulated to tackle a broad spectrum of staining including tannins, proteins, dyes, and oily marks on carpets, rugs, and upholstered surfaces. Available in a 5L trade size, it delivers consistent stain removal performance across large commercial cleaning operations.

name: Urine Stain Remover U301
description: A targeted enzyme and oxidiser formula developed specifically to break down urine crystals, neutralise uric acid odours, and remove the visible staining left by pet or human urine accidents on carpet and upholstery. Its dual action formula both removes the stain and permanently destroys the odour compounds rather than masking them.

name: Leather Cleaner L708
description: A pH balanced leather cleaning solution formulated to safely remove ingrained dirt, body oils, dye transfer, and surface soiling from all types of finished leather upholstery, car interiors, and leather goods. Its low pH formula cleans effectively without stripping protective coatings or drying out the leather's natural moisture.

name: Leather Conditioner L808
description: A nourishing leather conditioner enriched with lanolin and moisturising agents that replenish the natural oils lost through regular use, preventing cracking and maintaining the suppleness of leather upholstery and accessories. Applied after cleaning, it restores a soft, natural finish and provides a protective barrier against future soiling.

name: Guard Leather L908
description: A water based leather protector that forms an invisible barrier on finished leather surfaces, repelling liquids, body oils, and dye transfer to keep leather upholstery cleaner for longer between professional services. Applied as a final step after cleaning and conditioning, it significantly reduces the adhesion of soils and staining agents.
